title: Synergic effect and biosafety of chitosan/zinc complex nanoparticle-based carboxymethyl cellulose coatings for postharvest strawberry preservation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,15539-15549
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00140D, Paper

Ha Thi Thu Bui, Le Thi Thanh Dang, Hue Thi Nguyen, Le Thi Le, Huy Quang Tran, Thuy Thi Thu Nguyen
CS/Zn NPs were formed by chelating CS NPs with Zn2+ in the fresh zinc electrochemical solution. CS/Zn NP-based CMC coating reduced the strawberry spoilage and maintained fruit quality, indicating its potential application in fruit preservation.
